title: Run Playbook
description: Run a playbook by passing the playbook unique ID through the payload.

body.name: playbook_unique_id
body.description: Pass the unique ID of the playbook. You can retrieve the unique ID of a playbook using the **Get Playbooks** endpoint.

body.name: data
body.description: Pass the data or inputs as key-value pairs to run the playbook.

body.name: event
body.description: Pass the unique ID of the event to fetch the event data for playbook execution. You can retrieve the unique IDs of events using the **Get Source Events** endpoint.

body.name: runLog
body.description: Pass the unique ID of the run log to fetch the run log data of playbook execution. You can retrieve the playbook result's unique ID using the **Get Playbook Run Logs** endpoint.

body.name: email_notification_details
body.description: Pass the email addresses to receive notifications when input is required to proceed with the playbook run. Provide a JSON containing `from_email`, `user_emails`, and `redirect_url` to notify external users.

items.name: user_emails
items.description: Pass a list of email addresses to notify external users when the playbook requires inputs to proceed with the playbook run.
Pass the email IDs of the users to receive the notifications.

items.name: from_email
items.description: Pass the email address that will be used to send the email notifications. By default, the system retrieves the `from_email` from the SMTP configuration in Orchestrate.

items.name: redirect_url
items.description: Pass the redirect URL for the response button in the email. Add the URL of the Orchestrate page where users will be directed after clicking the button.

body.name: playbook_result_unique_id
body.description: Returns the unique ID assigned to the playbook result. You can retrieve the detailed playbook run details using the **Get Playbook Run Log Details** endpoint.
